_comment: Gen-5 Elysium MAINNET config (99901). Filled 2026-11-09 during mainnet prep. Every address bytecode-/identity-verified on 99901 — see docs/reports/elysium-mainnet-2026-11-09.md for how each was verified. Mainnet is a pure config swap: same scripts as testnet, this file. DEPLOY ORDER: (batch 1) create the Safe via the canonical v1.3.0 proxy factory at the DETERMINISTIC address below, THEN (batch 2) run DeployElysium.

infra._comment: All verified present on 99901 (cast codesize). create2Deployer is exactly 69 bytes = canonical Arachnid deployer. Safe v1.3.0 canonical contracts ALREADY have code on 99901 — no Safe infra deploy needed.
infra._safeSingletonNote: GnosisSafeL2 v1.3.0 (per Rizky — L2 variant, stays Safe{Wallet}-compatible if Elysium is added). Code present on 99901 (23800b). The L1 GnosisSafe singleton 0xd9Db270c... is also present if ever needed.

tokens._comment: whype: name/symbol WHYPE, decimals 18 (verified on 99901). usdc: symbol USDC, decimals 6 (USDC.e). USDC is NOT a green quote asset on launch (WHYPE only); recorded for reference.

v4._comment: poolManager: genuine Uniswap v4 PoolManager — byte-identical to the official 4663 v4 PoolManager except its 20-byte self-address (solc 0.8.26). CONFIRMED by Rizky as Elysium's canonical v4 (also used by 0x Settler PR #701, merged Nov 3). On-chain: owner()=0xA9aE0c5eb238a519b7f5Af27415eb6Dd0744Da8D, protocolFeeController()=0x0 (no Uniswap protocol fee set). universalRouter: Uniswap UR v2.2.0 — code present, poolManager()==0xE2e105..., WHYPE+Permit2 embedded as immutables; from Uniswap/universal-router PR #534 (verified, PR pending merge). Chose v2.2.0 over v2.1.2 (0xA13f7611...4b45) because neither matches our 4663 minHopPriceX36 fork encoding, so the tiebreak (v2.2.0) applies. The DeployElysium script reads ONLY .v4.poolManager; the rest is frontend/SDK-only. FRONTEND NOTE: Elysium swaps need STANDARD v4 UR encoding (NO minHopPriceX36) — do not reuse the 4663 calldata path. positionManager/stateView/v4Quoter still to source (reads/LP only).
v4._universalRouterNote: v2.2.0 selected; verified, Uniswap PR #534 pending merge

params._comment: protocolBurnDestination = the Ballast Safe (2-of-3) — burn-design option 1: WHYPE accrues to the Safe for $BALLAST buyback & burn once a bridge is live. IMMUTABLE in the vault at construction.

router._comment: FeeRouterV5 construction params, shared across every launch.

owner._comment: protocolOwner = the Ballast Safe (GnosisSafeL2 v1.3.0, 2-of-3). DETERMINISTIC address, proven on an anvil fork of 99901 via createProxyWithNonce(singleton=0x3E5c6364... (GnosisSafeL2), initializer=setup([0xBfD4F1E8,0x3810a51b,0x594527d8], threshold=2, 0, 0x, fallbackHandler=0xf48f2B2d..., 0,0,0), saltNonce=0x42414c4c4153540001). getOwners/getThreshold/VERSION/slot0-singleton all confirmed. Must be deployed (batch 1) BEFORE the gen-5 core (batch 2). The factory is handed over via Ownable2Step; the Safe calls acceptOwnership() (batch 3, approveHash+execTransaction flow).

safe._comment: Record of the Safe deployment params so Rizky can reproduce the exact deterministic address. Owners copied from the Robinhood-Chain Safe (0xEFC97e16...) getOwners; threshold RAISED to 2 (the RH Safe was 1-of-3 at read time — Rizky raising it separately). Uses GnosisSafeL2 singleton.
